{{Current events header|2016|07|28}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defense Minister]] [[Sergei Shoigu]] says [[Russia]] and [[Syria]] will open humanitarian corridors to [[Aleppo Governorate|Aleppo]], and will provide a way for [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] fighters to lay down their arms. [http://www.cbsnews.com/news/russia-announces-humanitarian-operation-in-besieged-aleppo/ (CBS News)] 
**The Syrian government offers an amnesty for rebels who surrender within three months. [http://www.huffingtonpost.com/entry/assad-amnesty-syria_us_5799d334e4b01180b531cc93 (Huffington Post)]
**The leader of [[Al-Nusra Front]], [[Abu Mohammad al-Julani]], announces that the group is splitting from [[Al-Qaeda]] and that new operations will be carried out under the name [[Jabhat Fateh al-Sham]], effectively disbanding the group. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/28/al-qaida-syria-nusra-split-terror-network (''The Guardian'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least 64 people die in [[Nepal]] after heavy [[monsoon]]al rain triggers floods and landslides. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-36911775 (BBC)] [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2016/07/nepal-hit-flash-floods-landslides-160728090756268.html (Al Jazeera)]
*Around 1.8 million people are affected, and the [[Kaziranga National Park]] is submerged, due to heavy rains causing [[2016 Assam floods|flooding]] in [[Assam]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/jul/27/flooding-in-india-affects-16m-people-and-submerges-national-park (''The Guardian'')]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–United States relations]]
**[[North Korea]] says the [[United States]] has "crossed the red line in our showdown" after placing sanctions on its [[List of leaders of North Korea|leader]] [[Kim Jong-un]] over human rights abuses, and considers the sanctions to be a "declaration of war" by the United States. [http://news.sky.com/story/us-declared-war-blacklisting-kim-jong-un-10515230 (Sky News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2016 Democratic National Convention]]
**[[Hillary Clinton]], if she accepts the party's nomination, will be the first female presidential nominee of a major political party in the United States. [https://www.bostonglobe.com/metro/2016/07/26/with-speech-thursday-time-for-hillary-clinton-get-real/dQzJYL31z2I1dM6agWuc1M/story.html (''The Boston Globe'')]

;Science and technology
*[[Kīlauea]], a [[shield volcano]] on [[Island of Hawaiʻi|the island of Hawai'i]], erupts [[lava]] into the ocean for the first time since 2013. [https://weather.com/news/weather/video/kilauea-volcanos-lava-oozes-into-ocean (''The Weather Channel'')]
